scope: Non-promotional risk support and sports statistics literacy
method: 50 individual web-search calls, source titles/URLs reviewed; not a localized Google rank measurement. Four primary reference pages opened; Arizona official source blocked fetch (not used for jurisdiction-specific claims).

search_console.note: Do not treat all exclusions as errors. Index report predates recent releases; baseline does not show ranking gains.

findings.observation: Results include checklist, self-assessment and official help formats.
findings.gap: Original page condensed warning signs into one paragraph.
findings.preview: Descriptive H1, scannable checklist, source link; does not diagnose.

findings.observation: Results distinguish deposit limits, time-outs, account closure and self-exclusion; geography changes coverage.
findings.gap: Original page named tools without explaining differences.
findings.preview: Plain-language definition list and jurisdiction limitation.

findings.observation: Official NCPG results provide state directory and explain helpline scope.
findings.gap: Original page had one broad support link.
findings.preview: Direct helpline/privacy and state-directory links; loved-one access explained.

findings.observation: Returned results include textbooks, research and definition/worked-example pages. Some queries drifted to sports medicine or horse racing.
findings.decision: Backlog only; narrow future articles to sports-media statistical literacy. Do not imitate irrelevant result formats or promise wagering advantage.

opportunities.evidence: UNBC, Cornell and Wesleyan source-evaluation guides returned for query 47
opportunities.asset_needed: An original sports-media source-checking worksheet with worked examples, reviewed before outreach
opportunities.limitation: No evidence these institutions accept KBH links or endorse it.

opportunities.evidence: SABR statistical graphics article returned for query 36
opportunities.asset_needed: An original non-promotional illustration of sample size and denominator errors
opportunities.limitation: No submission or contact permission inferred.

backlinks.not_recommended: Do not ask treatment charities to endorse a betting service. Direct readers to their official support pages. Outbound citations are not backlinks.

after_publication: Record actual publication date and exact changed URLs.
After several days, inspect canonical/index status and crawl date.
After one week, compare page-level clicks, impressions and query coverage using equal windows.
After one month, repeat and revise useful answers based on observed queries.
follow_up.status: Plan recorded; no scheduled job or future checks claimed complete. New content not deployed.
